guitar.evidence: Dan Auerbach is well documented as a collector and user of vintage budget guitars (Harmony, Supro, Guild, Silvertone) and Gibsons, giving The Black Keys their fuzzy, lo-fi blues-rock tone.

tone.target: raw fuzzy blues-rock riff with garage drive
tone.profile: raw fuzzy blues-rock riff with garage drive
tone.summary: A fuzzy signal chain using Red Haze for aggressive saturation, followed by the UK 45 amp model to capture the dirty British combo tone, finished with a gritty cabinet and minimal effects.
gearClues: small combo or dirty British amp

rig.name: The Black Keys - Howlin' For You - Valeton GP-180
